fields.description: Canalside Marina Residences is Sobha’s canal-side apartment collection on Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. The project documents show Towers A and B, with one- to three-bedroom layouts ranging from compact balconies to larger yards and terraces.

research.community: Canalside Marina Residences · Sobha Siniya Island
overview: The plans distinguish balcony apartments from homes with private yards or substantial terraces. The selected three-bedroom Type A has a particularly large outdoor component, so its saleable total should not be read as internal living space.
research.locationNote: Along a canal leading towards the Arabian Sea within Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain. Confirm tower, orientation, footbridge access and delivery of surrounding facilities. Marina or golf marketing does not itself grant free membership or a boat berth.
research.priceNote: Sobha advertises AED 1.36m subject to available inventory. Property Finder publishes a different starting selection reference. Neither a portal price nor the general developer headline confirms the price of a particular tower or furnished unit.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% launch down payment, 40% construction in four equal instalments and 40% handover. A Bayut building guide instead shows 10/40/50. Without a current developer sheet, the displayed plan is explicitly the portal-reported version; obtain written current terms.
research.handoverNote: The own project brochure prints December 2029, corroborated by Property Finder. Bayut’s building guide instead lists Q4 2026. That unresolved secondary discrepancy is not substituted for the developer document; contractual timing remains to confirm.

paymentStages.stage: Construction · four10% instalments; dates to confirm

facts.value: Sobha’s current page specifically describes fully furnished one- to three-bedroom residences in Tower A. Confirm the detailed inventory and Tower B specification separately.
